#file:Docs/Copilot/context-cursorfollow.md
#file:Docs/Prompts/implement-checklist.md

Diagnose the reported issue and fix it safely.

Checklist:

1. Reproduce or identify failure path from code and logs.
2. Isolate whether the issue is in tracking, capture, output-window rendering, transport, or extension/camera wiring.
3. Apply minimal targeted fix.
4. Validate with build and any practical runtime checks.
5. Report residual risks if system-level signing/permissions prevent full local verification.
